title: Queued GMCP work must get a prescriptive, write-first prompt
goal: A planned GMCP requirement task got a terse prompt, so the worker read a 9000-line test file until the turn cap and never wrote; only a hand-edited prompt naming the sibling test and requiring an early append made it write. Generate that order in the planner for gmcp_req_/gmcp_vc_ acceptances (sibling prefix, append within five turns, bounded reads) and the general write-before-ten-files order for every other task.
